title: fix(spec): the object-grid page-size migration entry states that a stored page still saves, with an advisory CLI finding
body:
Fixes #20860
Clause-②: no

The ADR-0087 D3 entry `ui-object-grid-page-size-positive-integer-refused` (protocol 18) said, in its `acceptanceCriteria`, that a stored page whose `object-grid` node carries `pageSize: 0` "is refused on its next authoring-path save with a per-key issue at `pagination.pageSize`". The save path does not do that. This PR corrects the sentence to the measured behaviour. It is a text-only change: no entry id, conversion, schema or matching logic moves.

## The two measurements (tree: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `6c96b37be8`, the branch base)

**1. The save.** The real `saveMetaItem` write path was driven over a stub engine. The harness is copied from `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, with an environment id and the default authoring channel, so the runtime authoring gate is live. The probe lived in scratch, not in the tree. `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` in `rest-server.ts` hands its body to this same call with `writeFace: 'meta-envelope'`, so the probe ran both faces. The HTTP door itself was not booted. Every case was saved, stored and read back through `getMetaItem`:

| page body (`object-grid` node `properties`) | both faces |
| --- | --- |
| `pagination: { pageSize: 0 }` | `success: true`, no `advisories` member, one `active` row, reads back `{ pageSize: 0 }` |
| `pageSize: 25.5` (flat shorthand) | `success: true`, one `active` row, reads back `25.5` |
| `pagination: { pageSize: 10, pageSizeOptions: [10, 0] }` | `success: true`, one `active` row, reads back as written |
| `pagination: { pageSize: 25 }` (well-formed) | `success: true` |
| control: a component `type: 'user:profile'` (retired by name) | refused: `422` `INVALID_METADATA`, issue at `regions.0.components.0.type` |

The control leg shows that the harness can return a refusal, so the successes above are real readings. The one runtime-publish rule registered for type `page` is not `validateComponentProps`. The registry reports `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('page')` has length 1, and it does not include that rule.

**2. The CLI.** The same page was run through `runAuthoringRules(command, …)` for each of `validate`, `build` and `lint`. `packages/cli/src/commands/{validate,compile,lint}.ts` call this function. The registry row is `validateComponentProps` with `tier=advisory`, `surfaces=["cli"]` and `commands=["validate","build","lint"]`. The output was identical for all three commands: 0 errors and 3 advisories.

```
warning component-props-invalid pages[0].regions[0].components[0].properties.pagination.pageSize | pagination.pageSize: Too small: expected number to be >0 (received 0)
warning component-props-invalid pages[1].regions[0].components[0].properties.pageSize | pageSize: Invalid input: expected int, received number
warning component-props-invalid pages[2].regions[0].components[0].properties.pagination.pageSizeOptions.1 | pagination.pageSizeOptions.1: Too small: expected number to be >0 (received 0)
```

The code read in the card holds. `PageComponentSchema.properties` is `z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())`. `validateComponentProps` / `ComponentPropsMap` have 0 non-test hits under `packages/metadata-protocol/src`, `packages/objectql/src`, `packages/metadata/src`, `packages/rest/src` and `packages/runtime/src`. The control hit is `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts:113`. The rule's own hint already says "the props bag is not parsed on the storage path either".

## The correction

`acceptanceCriteria` now says, in the wording triage gave: the page still saves and loads; `properties` on a page component is not parsed on the metadata save path; the component-props gate reports an advisory `component-props-invalid` finding at `pagination.pageSize` on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint`. Measurement 2 shows that a `pageSizeOptions` entry and the flat `pageSize` shorthand are reported the same way at their own paths, so the criterion says that too. It ends with the author's check: `os validate` reports no such finding for that node.

`surface`, `replacement` and `reason` were read for the same false claim. None of them states a save-path refusal, so they are unchanged.

**Sibling `object-grid-default-filters-rule-array`:** measured the same way. A bare string `defaultFilters: 'status'` and a malformed rule list `[{ field: 'status' }]` both save with `success: true` on both faces. The CLI gives one advisory `component-props-invalid` each, at `properties.defaultFilters` and at `properties.defaultFilters.0.operator`. The entry already says the key's door "refuses such a value only as the component-props gate's advisory finding (os validate, os build, os lint), since a re-save through the metadata API is not refused there". That is true, so the sibling is unchanged.

## Generated copy

`packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` was regenerated with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry` and was not edited by hand. It has one hunk. With leading whitespace stripped, its `+`/`-` lines are byte-identical to the entry file's (`cmp` exit 0, 10 lines each). The word-diff of both files shows the same replacement. `spec-changes.json` and the protocol upgrade guide project protocol 17 only. As measured, `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` are green with no regeneration, and neither file is in the diff.

## Changeset

`.changeset/20860-page-size-entry-advisory.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`. It is text-only because the entry ships in the package's `dist`.

## Local verification (all at head `a3fd6c8aef`)

- **Build:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` passed (exit 0). `@objectstack/spec` has no workspace dependencies, so step 1 of the closure build is empty.
- **Package tests:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2` gave `Test Files 579 passed (579)` and `Tests 17090 passed | 1 todo`. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exited 0 (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, `check:test-typecheck` OK). The public surface is unchanged (`check:api-surface`: "public API surface + factory signatures unchanged"), so no importer owes a test.
- **Derived gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 82 commands. Each exit code was captured to a file before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". 80 exited 0 on the first pass. `check:lean-entry-closure` exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, objectql `dist` absent), and after `@objectstack/objectql...` was built it exited 0. Named verdicts: `check:migration-registry` "registry.ts is current", `check:spec-changes` "spec-changes.json is up to date", `check:upgrade-guide` "protocol-upgrade-guide.md is up to date", `check:doc-authoring` clean, `check:nul-bytes` OK, `check:adr-0087-registration` "no declared-breaking changeset", `check:empty-changeset` OK.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** Reason: it loads the built CJS entry of every workspace package and needs a whole-workspace `pnpm build` (60+ packages have no `dist` here). This diff changes one string literal inside `@objectstack/spec`, whose own build passed. CI's Lint & Repo Gates and Build Core measure it.
- **Stale-tree note:** the gate list was derived at `a3fd6c8aef` (base `6c96b37be8`). By reconciliation time `origin/main` had moved 6 commits, and 4 files that families derive from had changed there (`check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`, an i18n-walk-parity fixture, one adr-anchor JSON, `role-word-baseline.json`). None of them reads this diff's paths. The branch is not merged with `main`, and CI measures the merge ref.
- **Not run locally, declared to CI:** `pnpm lint` (repo-wide, CI-owned), the type-check lanes and the path-scheduled jobs the derivation lists.

## Acceptance notes

- The released `@objectstack/spec` CHANGELOG entry for the narrowing (`9bb059d`) says "the `object-grid` page-component door now refuses a page size of `0`". That is true of the `ComponentPropsMap` parse. It does not name the save path, so it is not the false claim this card corrects. CHANGELOG is release-owned. Carrier: none.

**Owed before enqueue:** the at-tier contract review by the owning seat (review face `packages/spec/src/**` non-test). This PR does not carry that record.
